text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- A delagation from the Russian Duma continues its visit. In a meeting with the parliament speaker yesterday, the MPs said economic pressure may be applied to Latvia if does not comply with Russia's demands on the status of Russians in Latvia, including rights to vote in local elections.
- The president accredited the ambassadors of North Korea and Qatar.
- The Jane's defence research group says Moscow should not be allowed to dictate its will in matters of NATO relations with the Baltic states and Ukraine.
- Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov meets with NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana in Luxemburg today to discuss documents mapping out Russian and NATO relations.
- The Baltic states may enter the EU in a third wave of enlargement as they still have to improve their internal security, including border and police control.
